items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Later, of course, he [Ben Webster] went up to CBS and played with Raymond Scott's band.

ctx.x: Well, we're still on Jim and Andy's, which includes when you first came to New York and all the great band guys were there. Who were they?

Well, we started off with Jim and Andy's, I guess talking about Ben Webster and how I first met him. Later, of course, he went up to CBS and played with Raymond Scott's band. And that was a great band if you remember that.
Yeah, that was a great band. I remember that.
